fib: ______ is a metal that has the highest atomic weight of the primordially occurring elements.
Uranium is a metal that has the highest atomic weight of the primordially occurring elements.
______ are used in polyesterification processes while the chlorides and cerium phosphate are useful in petroleum cracking.
The anhydrous lanthanoid chlorides are used in polyesterification processes while the chlorides and cerium phosphate are useful in petroleum cracking.
______ are the only metals that occupy the f-orbitals.
Lanthanides and actinides are the only metals that occupy the f-orbitals.

Uranium oxide is one of the most complex oxide system known.
______ is used in the preparation of low dispersion, high refraction optical glass.
Lanthanum oxide is used in the preparation of low dispersion, high refraction optical glass.
______ are those having zero, one and seven unpaired electrons.
The colourless lanthanides ions are those having zero, one and seven unpaired electrons.
